description.en: The ID of the inventory task.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配表名等资产信息
description.en: The search keyword used for fuzzy matching of asset information such as table names.

The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- confidence
- entityId

Default value: confidence.

description.zh: 排序方向，可选值：asc（正序）、desc（倒序），默认desc
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

Default value: desc.

title.zh: 获取盘点结果的异步接口

descriptions.zh: 按与 SearchInventoryAsset / ExportInventoryAsset 相同的筛选条件提交异步导出任务，接口立即返回 exportTaskId（status=RUNNING）。后台生成 XLSX 并上传 OSS 后，通过 GetInventoryExportTaskStatus 轮询；status=SUCCESS 时返回预签名 downloadUrl。无需 Size/Offset，单次最多导出 50000 条。
descriptions.en: Submits an asynchronous export task using the same filter conditions as SearchInventoryAsset or ExportInventoryAsset. The operation immediately returns an exportTaskId (status=RUNNING). After the backend generates an XLSX file and uploads it to OSS, poll the task status by calling GetInventoryExportTaskStatus. When status=SUCCESS, a pre-signed downloadUrl is returned. Size and Offset are not required. A maximum of 50,000 records can be exported in a single request.
